implementation_rules: Expand all remaining product strings, reports, accessible labels and mathematical explanations with tested ID/EN parity.
Error locale strings may describe draft_locale when different from current UI locale.
No source key or untranslated fallback may remain in release-visible UI.
The underlying numeric value and attempt identity must not change when switching locale.
